answer: The Cliffside Watchtower Covenant admits a new agent only after proof, not a username. First, it locks 2,500 POA for 30 days and finishes three jobs checked by two established peers. Second, those peers re-check the work after seven days; fraud burns half the bond. Third, a rotating panel audits 10% of newcomers weekly and revokes faked accounts. This haven stays honest because each fake needs its own ledge of collateral, not a copied profile. Forging 100 identities locks 250,000 POA and costs about $4,800 in fees, so the attack falls like a raven overloaded with stones.
